name: Customer
definition: A customer of the specialising debit card business, identified by a unique integer customer ID and described by a customer segment and a billing currency.
scope: Customer-level analysis across the customer table; the same customer identifier links consumption records and transactions.

name: Customer Segment
definition: The market segment to which a customer belongs. Observed values are SME (small and medium enterprises), LAM and KAM.
scope: Customer-level grouping and filtering only. Distinct from the gas-station segment, whose value domain is disjoint.

name: Billing Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer settles consumption. Observed values are CZK and EUR.
scope: Customer attribute used to select customers who paid in euro or in CZK. It is not a property of individual transactions.

name: Monthly Consumption
definition: Customer consumption recorded for one calendar month in the year-month consumption table. It is a pre-aggregated monthly amount per customer, not the sum of transaction prices.
scope: Customer-month level; the primary measure for consumption questions over months and years.

name: Year-Month Period
definition: The calendar month of a consumption record, stored as a six-character YYYYMM string whose first four characters are the year and whose last two characters are the month.
scope: Time dimension of the consumption table; month-level granularity, not a full date.

name: Gas Station
definition: A gas station where card transactions take place, identified by a unique gas station ID and described by chain, country and station segment.
scope: Station-level analysis and the station-side dimensions of transactions.

name: Gas Station Chain
definition: The chain number to which a gas station belongs; an integer value shared by many stations.
scope: Grouping and filtering stations and their transactions by chain, including references such as chain no. 11.

name: Gas Station Country
definition: The country in which a gas station is located, stored as a three-letter code. Observed values are CZE and SVK.
scope: Geographic filtering of stations and of the transactions that occur at them.

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: The commercial segment of a gas station: Other, Premium, Noname, Value for money, or Discount.
scope: Station-level classification only. Its values never occur as customer segments.

name: Product
definition: A product sold at gas stations (fuels, lubricants, car care, goods), identified by a unique product ID and described by a short description.

name: Product Description
definition: The short textual name of a product, for example Nafta, Natural, Diesel, or Oleje,tuky.

name: Transaction
definition: A single card purchase at a gas station, carrying date, time, customer, gas station, product, quantity and price.
scope: Event-level analysis. The stored table is a 1000-row sample covering only 2012-08-23 through 2012-08-26.

name: Transaction Date
definition: The calendar date on which a transaction took place, stored as a YYYY-MM-DD text value.
scope: Date filtering and day-level grouping of transactions.

name: Transaction Time
definition: The clock time at which a transaction took place, stored as HH:MM:SS text.
scope: Time-of-day filtering and distinct-time listing for transactions.

name: Transaction Quantity
definition: The number of product units purchased in one transaction. Price divided by quantity yields a stable per-unit price for fuel products.
scope: Transaction-level quantity; applies to the transaction table only.

name: Transaction Price
definition: The total price paid for one transaction, in the transaction's currency units.
scope: Transaction-level monetary value; it is not comparable to pre-aggregated monthly consumption over many purchases.

name: Annual Consumption
definition: The total consumption of a customer or customer group over a calendar year, formed by summing that year's monthly consumption records. Average monthly consumption for the year is the annual total divided by twelve months.
scope: Derived metric for yearly comparisons; its value depends on which months are present in the consumption table.

name: Consumption Growth
definition: The year-over-year change in annual consumption, expressed either as an absolute difference or as a percentage of a base year's consumption.
scope: Derived comparison metric between two calendar years for a customer group.
